question: A boat takes 90 minutes to go 49.2 km upstream. The ratio of the speed of the boat in still water to that of the stream is 3 : 2. How much total time (in hours) will the boat take to go 44.8 km upstream and 71.2 km downstream?
solution:
**Given:**

A boat takes 90 minutes to travel 49.2 km upstream. The ratio of the speed of the boat in still water to the speed of the stream is 3:2.

Distance upstream = 44.8 km

Distance downstream = 71.2 km

**Formula used:**

Speed of boat in still water (B) : Speed of stream (S) = 3:2

Total speed upstream = (B - S)

Total speed downstream = (B + S)

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

Time taken upstream = 90 mi
